q: Fluid can exert pressure by virtue of their weight.
e: True. Fluid can exert pressure by virtue of their weight. A fluid presses on a surface because of its weight.

q: Fluid represents states of matter that take the shape of their containers.
e: True. Fluid represents states of matter that take the shape of their containers. A fluid has no fixed shape. It takes the shape of the container.

q: Fluid is either liquid or solid.
e: False. Fluid means liquid or gas, not solid.

q: The pressure exerted on a body by the atmosphere, due to the weight of the atmosphere is called atmospheric pressure.
